title: RX-ADS: Interpretable Anomaly Detection using Adversarial ML for Electric Vehicle CAN data
reasoning: The paper discusses 'Trustworthy AI' and 'Explainable AI (XAI)' as means to improve user trust and aid in model debugging and diagnostics by understanding black-box AI models. This is a practical approach to system interpretability and reliability, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
